children: American Rebel executed a series of balance-sheet transactions in August 2026 to reduce debt and simplify its capital structure. The company exchanged 9,600 shares of Series D Preferred for $72,000 of Series E with Horberg, then converted those 72 Series E shares into 602,491 common shares. It also settled a $787,500 Agile term loan through issuance of 1,333,111 common shares valued at $0.1125 per share, fully satisfying the debt. Separately, American Rebel and Streeterville exchanged a $155,000 partitioned secured note for 1,000,000 common shares, reducing the original note’s outstanding balance. In total, the company issued approximately 2.94 million shares through these exchanges.
